items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well after Arnold had passed, who were some of those other bands that you just splattered around with and stuff?

ctx.x: Yeah, he was an age of a man at the time. Of course I worked with Glenny also, you know, I hired Glenny on different jobs too, you know. I needed a band. So I said I played most of the old age I played with.
Well after Arnold had passed, who were some of those other bands that you just splattered around with and stuff?

None in particular, like I said, Renee, Chris, Guy Kelly, he was with Celestine Warr, and the time he'd get work, you know. Split the band, I'd work in their place. I was mostly hired out like that. And one small orchestra, with myself, let me see Rochon, where he's living, he's preaching now.
